name: Corn cake
summary: Bánh ngô is corn cake, one of the three local cakes of the Sa Pa table with bánh đao and bánh dầy.
howToEat: In the highlands, corn cakes are eaten with thắng cố and corn wine.
seoTitle: Corn cake in Sapa — a highland cake
